_comment: Local MITRE ATT&CK knowledge base. Kept offline on purpose so the demo never depends on the internet. Maps each ACT correlation rule to its ATT&CK technique(s) and to a kill chain stage.

techniques.name: Account Discovery: Local Account
techniques.description: The attacker probes for usernames that exist on the host before choosing a target.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Repeated password guesses against a known account.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: Password guessing spread over many source addresses to stay under per-address limits.

techniques.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
techniques.description: The guessing that produced the working password.

techniques.name: Valid Accounts: Local Accounts
techniques.description: The attacker now holds working credentials for a local account.

techniques.name: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism: Sudo and Sudo Caching
techniques.description: Attempting to run commands as root through sudo.

techniques.name: OS Credential Dumping: /etc/passwd and /etc/shadow
techniques.description: Reading the local password hashes for offline cracking or reuse.

techniques.name: Create Account: Local Account
techniques.description: A new local account so access survives a password change.
